title: BIG Bone
body:
"Wow, this is REALLY dry!"

Description

A BIG Bone can only be obtained from killing the Skeleton King in Acidlands. When a Skeleton King is killed, it will typically drop around 3-5 BIG Bones.

It can be sold for $1,250 to Jer Junkman.

It takes the appearance as a normal Bone, but is larger in size.
